name: skill-rsi
description: Open the Skill RSI local app and prepare fresh Agent Skill improvement projects from Codex.

interface.shortDescription: Create and improve Agent Skills with local recursive evaluation loops.
interface.longDescription: Skill RSI turns Agent Skill development into a recursive experiment loop: Codex researches the goal, builds or improves a champion skill, tests a focused challenger against it, and repeats with the evidence preserved.
defaultPrompt: Create a new Skill RSI project.
